title: Argument encoding and transducer output
statement: For every finite list $\mathrm{args}$ of natural numbers and every finite bit string $r$, the output of the transducer started in state $a$ on the concatenation of the encoded list of unary encodings of $\mathrm{args}$ with $r$ equals its output when started in state $g$ on $r$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of natural numbers.
